Strippable Mushroom Blocks

Vanilla Minecraft lets you strip logs with an axe to change their appearance, but mushroom blocks? Those have always been left out.

This mod adds axe-stripping behavior to the three mushroom blocks - red mushroom block, brown mushroom block, and mushroom stem. Rather than swapping the block for a new "stripped" variant (there are none in vanilla), it works with the blocks' existing face properties. Each face of a mushroom block can independently show either the patterned skin texture or the plain inner pore texture, and this mod lets you toggle them.

How it works:

Right-click any mushroom block face with an axe to toggle that face between its two states
Sneak + right-click to toggle all six faces at once
Works with any axe (wood, stone, iron, gold, diamond, netherite, and modded axes)
Uses 1 durability per interaction, just like stripping a log
No new blocks, no new items - purely vanilla block states
This is useful for builders who want more control over the appearance of mushroom blocks without having to hunt for naturally generated mushroom structures with the exact face arrangement they need.
